title: TrailTransfer command
description: A command published to trailtransfer/{worker_id}/commands. The schema is closed: no additional properties are allowed (no free-form rclone args).

job_id.description: Client-supplied unique job id. Required; deduplicated by the worker.

source.description: Source path; must sit under an allowed_sources root. Required for copy/move/sync/check.

target.description: rclone remote/path (alias:path); must be in allowed_targets. Required for copy/move/sync/check.

recursive.description: Default true. When false, rclone runs with --max-depth 1.

filters.description: Glob patterns mapped to rclone --include (validated; may not start with '-').

dry_run.description: When absent, the policy's dry_run_default applies.

target_job_id.description: The job to act on. Required for action=cancel and action=status.

operator.description: Optional self-declared issuer identity, recorded in evidence.

reason.description: Optional human justification, recorded as result.justification.
